description: Torrential rains (~36 h) flooded streets and houses in Beach and Jabalia camps with sewage-laden water; UNRWA opened an emergency shelter in the north.
notes: No displacement count. UNRWA supplied 30,000 L diesel for sewage/storm-water pumps. GLIDE FF-2008-000216-PSE ('36 h of torrential rain').

description: Wadi Gaza flood at Al Mughraqa and Juhor ad-Dik: 50-70 cm to 2 m of water inside houses; livestock and poultry losses.
notes: people_affected_un = ~800 residents temporarily evacuated (mostly Bedouin). RCRC (IFRC DREF MDRPS004, PRCS): homes_destroyed=5; homes_partly_destroyed=11; ~100 families evacuated to a school (15 lost homes, 85 displaced). ~500 sheep, hundreds of chickens lost (OCHA). PRCS/IFRC say an upstream dam release / inflow from the Green Line worsened the flood - a claim, not a UN finding. GLIDE FL-2010-000015-PSE. IDMC: 500 displaced.

description: Windstorm: greenhouse, open-field crop and fishing losses (~US$3M in Gaza).
notes: 'Early December' read as 1-10 Dec; exact days not stated. Source date is UNISPAL's; text written after 17 Jan 2011. Figures are NGO (PCHR press release 20 Dec 2010) via OCHA: 1,750 dunums of greenhouses and 3,000 dunums of open field damaged; fisheries directorate (Authority): 250 fishers affected, 7 large boats, 40 hasakas, 600 nets lost. Wind event, not flood.

description: Floods and cold wave across the oPt including Gaza; parts of Gaza 'still flooded' a week later.
notes: RCRC only (no OCHA product checked): >300 families evacuated oPt-wide; PRCS relief to 60 families / 381 persons in Gaza; UNRWA blankets/heaters to 88 Gaza refugee households (relayed by IFRC). Rain >125% of average (oPt-wide). End date approximate (storms 'from 28 February onwards', worse on 2 Mar). GLIDE FL-2012-000037-PSE. IDMC: 1,200 displaced (oPt).

description: Winter storm: flooding mainly in Rafah, high winds in Gaza City; rain-induced tunnel collapses.
hh_affected_scope: families temporarily displaced in Gaza (OCHA preliminary field reports)
deaths_source: other: 1 worker killed in a rain-induced tunnel collapse (2 still reported missing, 3 injured) - OCHA SitRep, source unnamed (OCHA does not itself monitor non-conflict deaths).
source_publisher: OCHA oPt Winter Storm SitRep (via UNISPAL)
notes: homes_damaged_un=530 (43% Gaza City, 22% Rafah area; of >1,570 oPt-wide). ~650 people displaced oPt-wide. MoSA (Authority) distributed >2,700 food packages. '>260 mm in 48 h' refers to the northern West Bank, not Gaza. GLIDE FL-2013-000002-PSE; EM-DAT 2013 riverine flood (oPt) 12,500 affected.

description: Storm Alexa: heavy rain 8-13 Dec, storm 11-14 Dec; Sheikh Radwan and other stormwater lagoons overflowed on the evening of 14 Dec (Sheikh Radwan ~4 km2, ~3 m deep); mass evacuations; large agricultural losses.
hh_affected_scope: displaced families given WFP food (response count, 'around 10,000 people')
deaths_source: UN (OCHA): 2 deaths and 108 injuries admitted to Gaza hospital ERs (16 Dec), mostly CO2/smoke inhalation from heating fires. cold: 1 infant (OCHA 14 Dec, 'initial reports'); other: 1, cause not given by OCHA (Al Jazeera/MoH: a 22-year-old, smoke inhalation). OCHA death figures are hospital/MoH-derived.
exposure_note: Al Amal pond (Khan Younis, 500,000 m3) expected to overflow; 20,000 people at risk of displacement (OCHA 14 Dec).
notes: people_affected_un = 21,000 'people's homes were damaged, but some 15,000 did not leave' (OCHA 16 Dec); later restated as 'at least 21,000 homes which need major repairs' (31 Dec) and as 21,000 'temporarily displaced' (OCHA Nov 2014 retrospective). Evacuated: ~10,000 at peak (OCHA 14 and 31 Dec; 16 Dec highlights say ~6,000); 5,246 people (1,129 families) in emergency shelters on 14 Dec. homes_damaged_un=1500 (>1,500 houses, North Gaza and Gaza City, 14 Dec). Sheikh Radwan: 250 dunums, ~1,000 households flooded, water to 6.5 m (WASH Cluster, 31 Dec); flooding in >=25 locations (CMWU). Rain 8-13 Dec ~75% of normal winter rainfall (OCHA 16 Dec) / 77% of average annual (OCHA bulletin 31 Dec) / 92% of seasonal (MoA) - conflicting denominators. NOT used: '40,000 displaced' (IPS 20 Dec 2013, unattributed). PRCS relief 3,323 families / 19,950 persons (RCRC). Hamas government via Al Jazeera: 5,246 evacuated (Authority). GLIDE CW-2013-000153-PSE; IDMC 10,000 (WB+Gaza); EM-DAT oPt winter storm 50,071 affected / 1 death.

description: First post-war winter rains: localized flooding in Gaza City (Sheikh Radwan, Nafaq, Manara, Saftawi), Khan Younis, Jabaliya and Beit Lahiya; UNRWA declared an emergency in Gaza City on 27 Nov.
hh_affected_scope: people displaced to UNRWA collective shelters (most left soon after the rain)
notes: Also 'hundreds' around the Sheikh Radwan lagoon moved to upper floors; no injuries. UNRWA: 63 Gaza City schools closed for the afternoon shift. IDMC: 200 displaced, 27-30 Nov 2014.

description: Storm 'Huda': cold exposure of families in war-damaged homes and caravans; localized flooding in Rafah, Khan Younis and the Middle Area (Wadi Al Salqa).
deaths_source: cold: UN (UNICEF SitRep, no source cited): 4 children aged 1-18 months died on 9, 10, 11 and 13 Jan. OCHA relays MoH (2 infants) plus local media (2 more, incl. a fisherman); IFRC: 3 children + 1 adult, oPt-wide.
source_publisher: UNICEF oPt SitRep (3-15 Jan 2015, via UNISPAL)
notes: Window extended to 13 Jan for the last named death (OCHA storm window 6-10 Jan). ~9 injured (OCHA). Civil Defence (Authority): >80 rescue and >50 evacuation missions. PRCS relief: 625 families / 4,012 persons in Gaza (RCRC). NOT used: IFRC '10,000 displaced' (recycled Alexa text); IDMC 10,000 (WB+Gaza) may derive from it. Wadi Gaza stayed within the anticipated level. GLIDE CW-2015-000002-PSE.

description: Second 2015 winter storm: 'no major impact on the Gaza Strip' (OCHA).
notes: Kept as a no-impact storm. OCHA: evening of 19 Feb; IFRC: 19-23 Feb. Hazard type not specified beyond 'storm'. PRCS relief to ~350 families oPt-wide (RCRC).

description: Heavy rain: tin roofs of 3 houses collapsed (Nuseirat / Deir al Balah camps); 2 houses submerged in southern Gaza; schools closed 25-26 Jan.
hh_affected_scope: people evacuated by Civil Defense (13 on 24 Jan, 7 on 25 Jan), per UNRWA
notes: NOT used: IDMC '510 displaced, 20-27 Jan 2016' (not supported by UNRWA SR128).

description: 'Mild rainfall' flooded several houses, stores and vehicles in Gaza City and the al-Nafaq sewage pump station (no grid power).
exposure_note: ~60 low-lying communities with >560,000 people at risk of flooding 'even from light rainfall' (WASH Cluster via OCHA, Dec 2017).
notes: No counts. Shows low rain totals can cause impact when grid power is off (mobile pumps ran 12-18 h).

description: Heavy rains flooded homes across the Gaza Strip.
exposure_note: 235,000 people in 39 low-lying areas at risk of flooding (WASH Cluster via OCHA, 17 Dec 2019).
notes: homes_flooded_un=2000 ('approximately 2,000 homes have already been flooded', OCHA 'initial reports', source unnamed).

description: Winter storm / cold wave: homes flooded after heavy rains.
hh_affected_scope: families temporarily displaced or impacted (OCHA Gaza snapshot, approximate)
deaths_source: other: RCRC (IFRC DREF MDRPS011) - 2 deaths in Gaza 'due to the heavy rains and flooding' (cause detail not given).
notes: OCHA gives no day; start from IFRC ('Saturday 18 Jan'); end not stated. PRCS relief 636 families / 3,975 persons in Gaza (RCRC). IFRC 'total affected' 30,000 is oPt-wide. Farm damage blamed on dam releases (>US$500k, 332 ha) is a media claim via ACAPS. GLIDE CW-2020-000026-PSE. IDMC 'Winter Storms - Gaza' 18 Jan-19 Mar 2020: 10 displaced.

description: Flood in Gaza listed by IDMC only.
notes: IDMC only: 'Flood - Gaza - 15/11/2020', 70 displaced (not a UN figure). Not corroborated: the OCHA Gaza Strip Snapshot for Nov 2020 has no flood item. Treat as unverified.

description: Heavy rainfall damaged crops in northern Gaza (mostly strawberries).
notes: Agricultural damage only: 471 dunums, ~US$675,000 losses, 246 farmers affected (OCHA, source unnamed).

RCRC only: PRCS relief to 376 families / 2,174 people in Gaza (since 27 Jan); IFRC oPt 'total affected' 3,500. The 4 deaths were in the West Bank (heating); no Gaza deaths stated (cells left empty, not 0). Season-to-date rainfall to 10 Feb: Gaza 104%, Beit Hanoun 114% of average (Met Office via IFRC). End not stated. Storm name 'Hiba' not supported by any source. GLIDE CW-2022-000163-PSE.

description: Flood in the Gaza Strip listed by IDMC only.
notes: IDMC only: 'Flood - Gaza Strip - 08/11/2022', 224 displaced (not a UN figure). OCHA POC reports 25 Oct-21 Nov 2022 contain no weather items. Treat as unverified.

description: Flooding submerged homes and farmland in Deir al Balah governorate (Deir al Balah, az-Zawaida, al-Bureij camp) and al-Qarara (Khan Younis).
notes: Media only (MEMO 27/12/2022, IMEMC 25/12/2022) via ACAPS; no counts. Media claim Israeli dam/levee gates were opened - cause unverified; may not be rain-driven.
